statusDetail: Attempted browser navigation and recon at https://www.cardmarket.com, but Cloudflare returned “Sorry, you have been blocked” (Ray ID observed in the captured DOM) instead of the target site. The site templates and journeys were therefore inaccessible.

page.notes: Target application could not be profiled. Cloudflare served an anti-bot block page.

artifacts.caption: Desktop capture of the Cloudflare block page returned instead of Cardmarket.
Mobile capture of the same Cloudflare block page.
Rendered DOM proving the response title is “Attention Required! | Cloudflare”, the H1 is “Sorry, you have been blocked”, and robots is noindex,nofollow.
Recon probe showing only the Cloudflare block content and one external Cloudflare link.
